title: xDrip not connecting to Dexcom share.
body:
Navid Fo suggested that I post my issue here.  I was using Nightscout to pull data from my DD to have on my phone and Garmin watch.  Something happened and I could not longer get data so I moved to using SugarMate to pull data from Dexcom Share to have data on my watch and a widget on my phone.  When that was no longer an option.  I started the process of taking advantage of Nightscout (from scratch - i deleted all previous Nightscout work in github and heroku).  
I started from scratch following the directions for the classic DIY installation.  I have accounts in Github, Heroku and MongoDBatlas. I have Nightscout working and Dexcom share is working.  I cannot figure out how to get data to my Garmin Watch and a widget for my phone.  I downloaded xDrip.+  I have the most current version and I have followed all of the directions and read suggestions from the facebook pages but I cannot get xDrip+ to pull the data.  I an getting the following error: 10:50" Share login erroe" Publisher account password failed code:500.  
I have verified my Dexcom username and password are correct and I believe i have all of the settings correct (based on research from previous posts).   I seem to be so close but no data.  
Thank you for your help!
